label: Codeforces
terms_note: Public API: 'at most 1 time per two seconds' (otherwise status FAILED, 'Call limit exceeded'). Anonymous standings of regular contests only via GET with exactly one parameter, contestId (https://codeforces.com/apiHelp/methods#contest.standings).

discover.note: All regular (non-gym) contests, upcoming first, then finished ones newest first; the method takes no filters, so the server filters locally (query: substring of the title; kind: every contest is coding; status: open = CODING, upcoming = BEFORE, completed = FINISHED) and pages the matches. status in the results is Codeforces' phase (BEFORE, CODING, PENDING_SYSTEM_TEST, SYSTEM_TEST, FINISHED).

get_competition.note: The Contest object from contest.standings (the API has no single-contest method); anonymous callers get it only for public regular contests that have started. Large contests answer several MB: the answer is held for 60 s and a following standings call for the same contest pages it without downloading it again.

standings.note: Official public standings; the API forbids from/count for anonymous callers, so the full ranklist is fetched and paged locally. raw has penalty and per-problem results.

not_offered.me: Authorized methods need an API key and secret with a SHA-512 apiSig (https://codeforces.com/apiHelp); this entry serves the anonymous public methods only.
not_offered.my_entries: user.status needs a handle, not an account session; no authenticated 'my entries' mapping in this public entry.
not_offered.enter: Registration is done on the website; the API has no registration method.
not_offered.submit: The API has no submission method (read-only API).
